task_description: Implement Phase 3: HTTP and Routing for the Doot DSL compiler. This adds the HTTP server runtime: route registration from parsed route declarations, ctx object construction, handler code generation stubs, response helpers, static file serving, embedded HTMX, error handling (auto-404, custom error pages, 500), group blocks with auth propagation, and CORS enforcement denied by default.

verification.summary: All 373 tests pass (259 Phase 1+2 + 114 Phase 3). Build compiles cleanly with --threads:on --mm:orc. 22 e2e tests make real HTTP requests to a running server. No Docker build configured for this project. Semantic review v2 APPROVED.
